name: agent-lp-harness: LP yield verifier (Celo)
description: Open-source harness that checks LP yield claims of concentrated-liquidity agents against public on-chain data: it replays pool state and compares modeled rewards with rewards a live position actually claimed. Celo: Uniswap V3 CELO/USDm fee-100 pool 0x2d70cbabf4d8e61d5317b62cbe912935fd94e0fe, reference position NFPM tokenId 202630 (the author's own). The harness is read-only and holds no keys. Self Agent ID 193 is an ID in a different registry (0xaC3D...5944), not this one.
